pages.text:
Hold right-click to charge, release to strike. Works on items on a $(l)Basin$(), $(l)Depot$() or $(l)belt$().

Charging past the threshold lands a $(l)critical hit$() on mobs too.

pages.title: Recipes it can do
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Basin$(): pressing (compacting) recipes$(br)$(li)$(l)Depot / belt$(): pressing recipes$(br)$(li)Plus any exclusive recipe you add via datapack

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)It reads Create's pressing recipes, so disabling a Create recipe also disables it here.$(br)$(li)Use a $(l)filter$() in the offhand to control outputs.$(br)$(li)Critical strikes only apply to the target you charged at, once.
